staffWorkspace.connectTeamLibraryLead: Your organiser can assign you to a covered library, or you can claim one yourself. Team membership and library staff access are separate.

staffOnboarding.title: Your library. *Your knowledge.*
staffOnboarding.lead: You know your library best. Claim its record to keep practical information current, share notices and connect your events.
staffOnboarding.libraryLead: Help people get the most from {name}. Claim staff access to look after its record, notices and event feeds.
staffOnboarding.claimIntro: If you work here, claim the library to keep its record up to date, manage event feeds and post notices. A moderator checks your claim before you get staff access.
staffOnboarding.pendingHint: Already submitted a claim? You’ll get access once it has been approved.
staffOnboarding.signIn: Sign in to your staff account
staffOnboarding.trustCopy: Staff access connects you with the library you work for. Your claim details are only seen by the moderators reviewing them.
staffOnboarding.publicCopy: Your library’s public page stays available to everyone. Community contributions continue alongside staff updates.
staffOnboarding.benefitsTitle: A useful page starts with you.
staffOnboarding.benefitsIntro: Help readers plan a visit with information that comes from the people who know the library.
staffOnboarding.recordCopy: Update opening hours, contact details, facilities and accessibility information so readers can plan their visit.
staffOnboarding.noticesCopy: Post library notices, from a temporary closure to a change in service, where people already look for information.
staffOnboarding.eventsCopy: Manage event feeds so your library’s activities can reach people browsing Libraries Global.
staffOnboarding.stepsTitle: From your first claim to staff access
staffOnboarding.findCopy: Search for its existing record and choose the library you work for. If it’s missing, you can suggest a new library first.
staffOnboarding.proofCopy: Give your role and the details that help confirm your affiliation, such as an institutional email or staff ID.
staffOnboarding.reviewCopy: Your claim is checked before access is granted. Once approved, your library appears in your Staff area.
staffOnboarding.evidenceNote: Have your role and supporting details ready. You can explain your connection to the library in the claim form.
staffOnboarding.eligibilityAnswer: People who work at the library and can explain their role and affiliation. If you’re a reader or visitor, you can still suggest corrections through the public library page.
staffOnboarding.missingQuestion: What if my library isn’t listed?
staffOnboarding.missingAnswer: Browse the index first to check for an existing record. If you can’t find one, suggest a new library through Contribute, then request staff access.
staffOnboarding.pendingQuestion: I’ve already sent a claim. What happens next?
staffOnboarding.pendingAnswer: A moderator checks the information you supplied. You can follow its progress in My submissions. Staff access becomes available after approval.
staffOnboarding.teamQuestion: What if my organisation has a Team?
staffOnboarding.teamAnswer: Ask your Team organiser about an invitation and library assignment. Team membership and staff access are related, but you still need an assignment to manage a particular library.
staffOnboarding.helpCopy: Ask a general question about the process in Discussions. Keep staff IDs and other private claim details in the claim form.

teamInvitation.joinedLibraryPending: Your Team membership is active. The library assignment for {library} needs a moderator’s review before staff access is available. You can check its progress in My submissions.
teamInvitation.lead: A shared workspace for your library team. Review your invitation, then join to start working with your colleagues.
teamInvitation.invitationIntro: This invitation connects the Team to the account you’re signed in to. Check the email and role below before joining.
teamInvitation.organiserDetail: As an organiser, you can invite colleagues and manage their library assignments. API access is bought separately on the Developers page.
teamInvitation.memberDetail: Your organiser manages library assignments. Libraries assigned to you will appear in your Staff area after you join.
teamInvitation.membershipNote: The workspace is free. Joining never grants library editing on its own: staff access covers only the libraries you’re assigned and verified for.
teamInvitation.joinError: Could not join. Please try again.
teamInvitation.expiredDetail: Ask {inviter} to send a new one.
teamInvitation.inactiveDetail: The site team has closed this workspace. Ask {inviter} to get in touch with them.
teamInvitation.wrongEmailDetail: This invite went to {email}. Sign out, sign in with that address, then open the link again.
teamInvitation.verifyDetail: Confirm your email address from your account settings, then come back to this link.
teamInvitation.joinedOrganiser: You organise this team: invite colleagues and assign them to its libraries.
teamInvitation.joinedLibrary: You now have {role} access to {library}. Your organiser can add more libraries at any time.
teamInvitation.joinedMember: Your organiser gives you access to the team’s libraries; any library already assigned to you is in your Staff area.
teamInvitation.nextIntro: Find your Team and assigned libraries in your Staff area.
teamInvitation.organiserStepDetail: Open Members & libraries to see your Team, invite colleagues and manage their roles.
teamInvitation.memberStepDetail: Open your Staff area to see your Team and any libraries you’ve been assigned.
teamInvitation.organiserLibrariesDetail: Assign colleagues to libraries covered by your Team. If a library is missing, ask the site team to add it.
teamInvitation.memberLibrariesDetail: Your organiser assigns the libraries you can manage. If none appear yet, ask them to check your assignments.
teamInvitation.updatesStepDetail: Once a library is assigned, keep its record current, post notices and connect event feeds from its staff workspace.
teamInvitation.helpDetail: Need help with the invitation? Contact the person who invited you, or
teamInvitation.existingTitle: Your account already has a Team
teamInvitation.existingDetail: You belong to {team}. Each account can join one Team. Ask its Organiser to remove your membership before joining another; an Organiser must first hand over their responsibilities.

workspaceDrawer.reviewPrivacy: Within your scope. Your own submissions are excluded.
workspaceDrawer.partialCounts: Some counts are unavailable. Open a queue to check.
workspaceDrawer.drivesLead: Organise a drive and help the community take part.
workspaceDrawer.staffUnavailable: The summary is unavailable right now. The links below still work.
workspaceDrawer.suggestedChanges: {count, plural, one {# suggested change to review} other {# suggested changes to review}}
workspaceDrawer.reviewBeforeLive: Review them before they go live.

workspaceDashboard.resumePromptBody: You have unfinished contributions. Continue one below, or dismiss this reminder and explore the hub. Your drafts will be kept.
workspaceDashboard.staffHelpBody: See what you can publish directly, what needs review and how your Team works.
workspaceDashboard.writingBody: Write about a library, a visit or a project. An editor reviews every story before publication.
workspaceDashboard.workHereBody: Claim your staff access to update your record, answer suggestions and post notices.
workspaceDashboard.editorBody: Editors maintain Knowledge and Journal articles in the languages they know.
workspaceDashboard.reviewBody: Use a source, explain what changed and keep each submission focused.
workspaceDashboard.reviewerBody: Check sources and local context. Ask for clarification when the evidence is incomplete.
workspaceDashboard.supportBody: Supporter recognises 100 accepted contributions, never payment. Organisations can sponsor the public service.
workspaceDashboard.quickBody: Know one of these libraries? Add a missing detail with a source. Changes go through the usual review.
workspaceDashboard.reviewStepOne: Add what you know, with a source where possible.
workspaceDashboard.reviewStepTwo: Check your changes and send them for review.
workspaceDashboard.reviewStepThree: A reviewer checks the evidence. Track updates in My submissions.
workspaceDashboard.resumeTitle: Pick up where you left off
workspaceDashboard.resumeBody: Continue saved drafts or respond to a reviewer. Drafts stay on this device.
workspaceDashboard.healthUnknown: Record checks unavailable. Open the staff record to try again.
workspaceDashboard.emptyFixes: You’ve skipped these suggestions. You can bring them back or choose another way to help below.
workspaceDashboard.resumeUnavailable: Your saved work couldn’t be loaded. Try again to see your drafts and review requests.

staff.publishes_straight_away_dates_use_the_li: Publishes straight away. Dates use the library’s timezone.
staff.an_open_ended_notice_stays_visible_for_3: An open-ended notice stays visible for 30 days.
staff.what_changes_for_which_dates_and_when_it: What changes, for which dates, and when it’s back to normal.
staff.publish_updates_for_visitors_or_reactiva: Publish updates for visitors, or reactivate a past notice.
staff.reactivate_a_notice_to_review_its_messag: Reactivate a notice to review its message and choose new dates.
staff.ended_and_expired_notices_will_stay_here: Ended and expired notices will stay here for reuse.
staff.it_stops_showing_on_the_library_page_and: It stops showing on the library page and in search straight away. You can reactivate it later from Past notices.
staff.i_confirm_this_key_may_spend_analysis_cr: I confirm this key may spend analysis credits or submit proposals on behalf of our API account.
staff.organisers_manage_the_subscription_overa: Organisers manage the subscription, overage and API keys. You can view usage.
staff.your_organisation_is_inactive_keys_canno: Your organisation is inactive. Keys cannot make requests until it is restored. Contact us for help.
staff.access_is_suspended_following_a_payment_: Access is suspended following a payment reversal.
staff.cancellation_is_scheduled_manage_api_bil: Cancellation is scheduled. Manage API billing to change it.
staff.organisers_manage_the_subscription_and_a: Organisers manage the subscription and API keys. You can view usage.
staff.no_usage_recorded_in_this_period: No usage recorded in this period.
staff.response_data_is_uncompressed_json_media: Response data is uncompressed JSON; media downloads aren’t counted. Totals include capacity reserved for requests still in progress. Failed, refused and timed-out requests don’t use your allowance.
staff.services_analysis_and_proposals_staged_a: Services, analysis and proposals · staged availability
staff.search_filters_country_region_librarytyp: Search filters: country, region, libraryType, operationalStatus and near (latitude, longitude and radius in metres).
staff.more_ways_to_use_library_data: More ways to use library data
staff.proposed_read_only_apis_for_public_data_: Proposed read-only APIs for public data. These endpoints are not available yet; paths and scope may change. They are not included in the current subscription.
staff.choose_the_libraries_your_team_covers_ad: Choose the Libraries your Team covers. Adding a Library does not verify staff access. Removing one ends the staff access this Team assigned there.
staff.your_account_has_more_than_one_existing_: Your account has more than one existing Team membership.
staff.each_account_now_belongs_to_one_team_con: Each account now belongs to one Team. Contact us to choose which membership to keep. We’ll check your library assignments before changing anything.
staff.the_invite_shows_below_nobody_was_emaile: The invite shows below. Nobody was emailed: the site team needs to configure email before invites can be sent.
staff.the_site_team_has_closed_this_workspace_: The site team has closed this workspace, so invitations and shared tools are paused. Each person’s own library staff access is not affected.
staff.assignments_need_moderator_review_unless: Assignments need moderator review unless they are covered by an approved service delegation.
staff.the_libraries_this_workspace_looks_after: The libraries this workspace looks after. Each person’s library staff access is assigned and checked separately.
staff.api_access_is_bought_separately_on_the_d: API access is bought separately on the Developers page. It never grants library editing.
staff.invitations_are_paused_while_this_worksp: Invitations are paused while this workspace is closed.
staff.they_sign_in_with_that_email_and_accept_: They sign in with that email and accept the link within 14 days. Library editing still needs verified access.
staff.verify_your_email_before_creating_a_team: Verify your email before creating a Team.
staff.your_account_has_older_memberships_to_re: Your account has older memberships to reconcile before opening its Team workspace.

staffRoute.counted_by_google_analytics_for_visitors: Counted by Google Analytics for visitors who accept analytics cookies, so refused consent and ad blockers make real visits higher than shown. Figures can take up to a day to appear.
staffRoute.traffic_reports_are_free_for_verified_st: Traffic reports are free for verified staff of this library. If your access changed recently, reload the page.

staffRoute.no_staff_libraries_match_this_selection: No staff libraries match this selection.

staffRoute.publish_record_changes_answer_suggestion: Publish record changes, answer suggestions and post notices for the libraries you run.
staffRoute.your_changes_to_this_record_publish_stra: Your changes to this record publish straight away. Moves, type changes and permanent closures still need review.
staffRoute.create_a_free_team_add_your_libraries_an: Create a free Team, add your libraries and invite your colleagues.
